title: Not the most comfortable, but you get what you pay for.
text:
Not the most comfortable, but you get what you pay for.. It’s not the most comfortable couch.
The pillows are sort of thin and resting backwards, you can feel the metal bars against your back. It’s a good temporary couch for anyone like me who has just moved and is on a budget. But please save up in the mean time for a more high quality couch lol… 😅
